name: Jezero Crater, Mars
description: Perseverance's field site: delta, crater floor and western rim. HiRISE 1 m DTMs over the rover traverse, CTX 20 m DEM over the whole crater.

name: New hub (3.144N, 155.311E)
description: Generated by Martian Map from real data: MOLA MEGDR 128 ppd (463 m): 100 %; CTX stereo DTM 20 m: 47 %; CTX orthoimage mosaic (6 m, resampled to 5 m): 24 %. Operations area DEM is 463 m: walking-scale slopes use a calibration from Jezero's 1 m data degraded to this resolution; boulders and scarps smaller than the DEM are not in the map (low confidence).

name: Jezero Crater east floor, Mars (CTX-only test site)
description: Portability test: an area with no 1 m DTM coverage, built only from the 20 m CTX DEM. Proves the pipeline and engine run on any site with a DEM; confidence and soft-soil uncertainty reflect the coarser data.
